chunks: And from him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Pray them with the dawn, before it, and after it.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: The dawn prayer time or fajr
key_terms.صَلِّهِمَا: Pray the two units being referred to
key_terms.قَالَ: He said, introducing the Imam's statement

ai.seo_question: When can the two rakʿahs of fajr be prayed according to Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling about the time of the two rakʿahs of fajr. It indicates flexibility in performing them with the dawn prayer, before it, or after it, within the discussed context of worship timings.
